clauses.evidence: tree = canonical [B5b-token-per-exiled-this-way]: SHUFFLE target player's library, CREATE_TOKEN controller TARGET_PLAYER, 2/2 black Zombie, count = cards of the chosen name moved HAND -> EXILE this turn. Packs (this packet's tree via --draft, and live): two hand copies -> exactly 2 Zombies, opponent's six-card library set intact after the shuffle (PASS); one hand copy + one library copy -> exactly 1 Zombie, 2/2 (PASS). Zombie colour B and controller from the tree (no pack lane).
clauses.issue: minor approximation, non-blocking: 'this way' is read as 'moved from that player's hand to exile this turn with the chosen name', so a second same-name exile from their hand earlier in the turn would also count (more Zombies for the opponent; weaker for the caster).
